title: AIVV User Preferences (Golden Additive Schema)
description: Golden additive schema for .aivv/config.json (project) and ~/.aivv/config.json (user). This is the current authoring target for all config keys. Legacy config.vN.schema.json files remain compatibility artifacts, but new additive keys are added here without claiming a new config.vN counter. Unknown keys are allowed for forward compatibility and surfaced by validate.sh unknown-key lint.

schema_version.description: Compatibility/minimum-reader metadata. Additive config-key work does not bump this value; bump only for a genuine breaking config format change.

default_lenses.description: Lens set used when callers do not select lenses. New setups default to general; an explicit configured or command-line lens set remains in effect.

fix_apply_policy.description: Per-category /aivv-fix apply policy. Values: auto=eligible for automatic application only after confidence/challenge/consequence gates pass; ask=route to the batched decision queue; skip=do not apply unless severity/disposition safety floors require escalation. improvement and clarification-needed default to ask. Invasive improvements are never auto-eligible. The schema default is the runtime default for omitted policy keys.

post_review_html_viewer.description: When true, /aivv renders a static HTML report after durable review/fix state is available. Recommended default for readability; first interactive setup asks before persisting the preference. Browser-open failures never fail review/fix workflows. Pair with post_review_html_open_mode to control link-only vs auto-open behavior.

post_review_html_open_mode.description: Controls what happens after a post-review HTML report is generated. link: show a clear Open report link/path without changing browser focus (recommended). open: ask the active platform adapter to open the report when it provides that capability; otherwise use the viewer’s OS opener. Open failures never fail the workflow.

default_M.description: Deprecated v1 spelling for default_lens_replicate. Readers should map this to default_lens_replicate when the modern key is absent; new writes should use default_lens_replicate.

project_kind.description: Optional project-kind metadata for setup and reporting. It does not derive or replace default_lenses.

outer_loop_severity_floor.description: Legacy fallback floor for outer-loop continuation when a finding lacks recommended_next_step. Current action gates prefer DISPOSITION (recommended_next_step fix-now/investigate-first) and consult this severity floor only for historical or incomplete findings.

lens_detection_mode.description: Smart lens detection (dev.154). Default/wizard ask reports optional ceiling candidates without adding them or blocking the requested review; manual-provenance ask requests a choice when interactive. smart adds relevant lenses within scope and announces the final method; off retains detect/report behavior. See review-shape-resolution.md for the mode contract.

severity_model.description: Selects the severity-derivation model. legacy_4pass: the current 4-pass blast-radius→tone→source-class→improvement inference (the shipped default). impact_likelihood: the forthcoming impact×likelihood model, under active rollout. Optional; absent ⇒ legacy_4pass.

project_context.description: Optional environmental context for impact×likelihood severity calibration and legal-applicability gating. deployment feeds the EXPOSURE sub-factor of likelihood. data_classes, jurisdictions, and compliance_targets tell reviewers when hard-statute compliance rules are applicable, inapplicable, or undeclared-context findings.

deployment.description: Deployment exposure profile. personal starts exposure low, internal starts medium, public can be high for ordinary/customer-facing paths.

data_classes.description: Declared data classes handled by the project. pii/payments/health/financial/credentials/confidential/children can raise impact and determine whether statute-specific privacy or safety rules are applicable; none means no regulated data class declared and is mutually exclusive with every other data class.

jurisdictions.description: Declared legal or market jurisdictions such as EU, US, UK, CA, or project-specific region tags. Used as applicability context; absence means the reviewer must state an applicability assumption rather than auto-applying a legal floor.

compliance_targets.description: Declared compliance commitments or contractual standards such as gdpr, ccpa, coppa, ada, section-508, eaa, wcag-aa, or project-specific target names. A declared target can turn an otherwise advisory rule into a required DISPOSITION floor.

severity_cell_map.description: Optional team override for the impact_likelihood defect-track 4x4 lookup table. Omitted cells use the shipped default in .aivv/methodology.md.

thoroughness.description: Persisted thoroughness dial tier. Resolved precedence: --thoroughness flag > repo key > user key > built-in default (balanced). balanced is the identity overlay (no behavior change). exhaustive is the runtime top tier (see skills/aivv/references/thoroughness-dial.md). Optional; absent ⇒ balanced.

direction.description: Toggles the graduated direction-challenge posture (fit-to-goal + negative-space reasoning). true (default after the R19 maintainer eval passed) = posture active; false = pre-feature review behavior. Flag --no-direction/--direction overrides this key for one invocation. Optional; absent ⇒ true.

scope_confirmation_mode.description: announce=show resolved scope/method before a clear explicit read-only review and proceed; a manually configured ask value requests scope/method confirmation each run. Old wizard/default ask values resolve in-memory to announce unless --ask-scope is explicit. Ambiguity, missing authority, or material scope expansion always requires clarification. v1–v5 configs predate the key and resolve to announce on read.

issue_sync_mode.description: Controls GitHub issue sync for local issue lifecycle mirrors. off=no GitHub operations; draft-local=local records only; confirm-github=plan remote operations but require explicit --confirm; auto-github=allow eligible non-sensitive operations without per-operation confirmation.

issue_sync_public_repo_policy.description: Controls publishing sensitive lifecycle issue content to public GitHub repositories. block-sensitive refuses sensitive records on public repos; confirm-sensitive requires explicit --confirm-sensitive; allow permits publication when the ordinary sync mode allows it.

multi_model_enabled.description: Feature gate for multi-model dispatch. When false (default), /aivv behavior is identical to v0.1.

model_policy.description: Runtime-backed model selection policy. aivv-recommended uses the central provider catalog. family-latest is a deprecated compatibility alias that currently resolves to the catalog recommendation because provider model-list ordering is adapter-specific. pinned uses model_overrides by provider ID; legacy reviewer_primary/secondary/fast values remain supported during migration.

model_overrides.description: Optional exact model IDs keyed by provider ID. Consumed when model_policy is pinned; a per-request model takes precedence.

reviewer_primary.description: Deprecated compatibility override for the provider assigned the primary legacy slot. Prefer model_overrides keyed by provider ID.

reviewer_secondary.description: Deprecated compatibility override for the provider assigned the secondary legacy slot. Prefer model_overrides keyed by provider ID.

reviewer_fast.description: Deprecated compatibility override for the provider assigned the fast legacy slot. Prefer model_overrides keyed by provider ID.

dispatch_strategy.description: How reviewer slots are activated. single: reviewer.primary only. parallel: all enabled slots. cascade: fast first, escalate to primary on low-findings+complex-diff. auto: rule-based routing (lens+security-pattern+size).

synthesis_enabled.description: When true, run the blind synthesis pass (Stage 6) to merge findings from multiple reviewers into a single attributed description.

parallel_quorum.description: Minimum fraction of dispatched reviewers that must respond before synthesis proceeds. floor(N * parallel_quorum) reviewers required.

reviewer_timeout_seconds.description: Per-reviewer hard timeout in seconds. AbortController cancels the fetch after this duration.

routing_rules.description: User override routing rules (max 4). Each rule is a structured object with when + strategy/slots. Rules evaluated in order; first match wins.

auth_mode.description: Default authentication mode used when the selected provider has no provider_auth_modes override. The active provider adapter defines the available authentication routes.

provider_auth_modes.description: Optional provider-specific auth mode keyed by provider ID. Each provider adapter defines which modes are supported. Unconfigured providers inherit auth_mode.

auth_mode_anthropic.description: Legacy compatibility alias for provider_auth_modes.anthropic. Prefer the generic provider_auth_modes map.

auth_mode_gemini.description: Legacy compatibility alias for provider_auth_modes.gemini. Prefer the generic provider_auth_modes map.

auth_mode_openai.description: Legacy compatibility alias for provider_auth_modes.openai. Prefer the generic provider_auth_modes map.

reviewer_provider_priority.description: Optional priority override using provider IDs from tools/model-catalog.json. An empty list derives the default order from the central provider registry. Reorder to change selection; omit a provider entirely to disable it even when available.

multi_model_fallback_strategy.description: What to do when a provider fails (quota, timeout, auth). ask (default): prompt the user with 4 choices (skip / replicate-with-default-provider / always-skip / always-replicate) — the last two persist the choice by rewriting this key to 'none' or 'subagents' respectively. subagents: dispatch one independent reviewer using the first resolved provider in reviewer_provider_priority per failed provider to maintain reviewer count — same behavior as --reviewers=N for the failed slots. none: proceed with only the successful providers' findings.

multi_model_disclosure_shown.description: Suppresses the data egress disclosure banner after first showing. Set to true manually or via the one-time banner prompt.

workspace_drift_policy.description: Behavior when workspace SHA drift is detected during reviewer dispatch. 'void' = original behavior (void the review immediately). 'warn' = continue with a warning banner. 'investigate' = orchestrator checks whether drifted files are in session scope AND whether any reviewer declared write tools; voids only when both checks indicate out-of-scope external write. Default 'investigate' reduces false-void noise from concurrent orchestrator state writes.

max_challenges_per_invocation.description: Token-budget circuit-breaker for Step 4.5 CHALLENGE. When N batches have been challenged in a single /aivv-fix invocation, remaining batches proceed to Step 5 without challenge.

max_rework_retries.description: Soft limit on /aivv-fix reworks (fix-plan re-authoring and verification re-entry) in one invocation. At the limit the agent stops and reports unresolved findings unless it records why one more rework is clearly justified.

class_breadth_triage_cap.description: Consumed by the class-breadth variant scan (Step 5 pre-loop). Max number of class_signature variant-scan sibling sites triaged+fixed per finding per cycle. Anchored to ~3x the >3-files high-blast-radius threshold. Above this count WITH duplicated-contract evidence routes to the architectural-remediation lane; above WITHOUT it defers the overflow as next-cycle sub-findings.

ambiguous_escalation_cap.description: Consumed by the class-breadth variant scan (Step 5 pre-loop). Max number of AMBIGUOUS class-sibling triage verdicts escalated to a full per-site investigator dispatch per finding. Beyond this, remaining AMBIGUOUS sites drop to class_sibling_triage[] verdict 'ambiguous-deferred' / reason 'escalation-budget-exhausted'. 0 = never escalate (defer all ambiguous).

shared_interface_patterns.description: Regex patterns for detecting shared interfaces in fix_proposal.files_to_modify. Paths matching any pattern trigger the 'touches_shared_interface' fix_confidence demotion predicate in Step 4.

enable_step_57_execution.description: When true, Step 5.7 ORCHESTRATOR EXECUTION runs new build-script / ci-gate / verification-method scripts post-EXECUTE and captures execution evidence for the verifier. Default false for the first 3 dogfood cycles per default-off ship discipline.
